reason: My Fresha page and Instagram already get me bookings, so I don't see why I'd pay a firm in Kuwait with no past clients to show. Handing 50% upfront over PayPal to people I've never met isn't happening.
objection: An AI bot answering my customers could get bookings or prices wrong, and if it messes up I'm the one who loses the client, not them. No UK clients and no reviews means I've got no way to know they're any good.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually working for another Manchester salon or barber I could ring up, plus a free trial month before I pay anything.
